theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_cri_rescaled_representation
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (P : Euclidean N → Grassmannian N n → Prop) (g : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞), (∀ A : Set (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n), MeasurableSet A → C.measure A = ∫⁻ x in {x | x ∈ M ∧ ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, P x T ∧ (x, T) ∈ A}, g x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → ∀ A : Set (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n), MeasurableSet A → rescaledMeasure C 0 s A = ∫⁻ w in {w : Euclidean N | s • w ∈ M ∧ ∃ T : Grassmannian N n, P (s • w) T ∧ (w, T) ∈ A}, g (s • w) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))
